text:
sophia (partnerships): Heads-up: onboarding runbook for Azure/AWS/GCP needs artifact signing + regional tax mapping. Can we align owners?
leo (eng): On artifacts: we can produce signed containers and signed AMIs. Need to decide if marketplace requires code signing certs or just hash manifests.
amir (azure-partner): Azure recommends AV2-signed artifacts and publisher SID mapping for marketplace offers. We can fast-track validation if artifacts are signed with a recognized cert.
ryan (finance): For APAC VAT/GST and EU VAT we need country-level classification. Also verify whether marketplace handles withholding tax or if we invoice direct.
tori (security): We'll need SBOM + signing keys rotated via KMS/HSM. Can we use a dedicated key per marketplace? also ensure supply-chain attestation in the manifest.
leo (eng): Example manifest I propose (simplified):
```
regions: ["us-east-1","eu-west-1","ap-southeast-1"]
artifacts:
  - type: container
    uri: gcr.io/redwood/redwood-inference:2026-03-15
    signature: sha256:abcd...
  - type: ami
    id: ami-0abcd1234
    signature: sha256:ef01...
sbom: s3://redwood-sbom/redwood-inference-20260315.spdx.json
```
amir (azure-partner): For Azure we'll need publisherResourceId and offerId in the package. I'll share sample ARM metadata.
sophia (partnerships): Question: single global SKU + region entitlements or per-cloud/per-region offers? pros/cons please.
leo (eng): Single SKU is easier operationally but marketplace billing + tax handling can be messy. Per-cloud offers let us map specific pricing and entitlements per provider.
ryan (finance): Prefer per-cloud offers initially so taxes and currency are isolated. Consolidate later after 1Q of telemetry.
tori (security): Also a security note: for on-prem/private deployments we need private image signing workflows. Document that separately.
marketplace-bot: onboarding checklist: https://internal.redwood/marketplace/onboard-v2 0 items pending: signing, SBOM, publisher-role, pricing-matrix
sophia (partnerships): Action list: 1) leo -> produce signed manifest + SBOM by Mon 2) amir -> sample ARM metadata and publisherResourceId by Tue 3) ryan -> tax treatment matrix (APAC/EU) by Wed 4) tori -> key rotation plan + HSM approach by Wed
leo (eng): I'll open a staging PR with CI that signs images and uploads manifests to staging marketplace bucket.
amir (azure-partner): Will loop in Azure validation team and confirm acceptance criteria.
ryan (finance): I'll coordinate with sales-tax ops and post the matrix here.
tori (security): I'll draft the key policy and share test vectors for signing verification.
sophia (partnerships): Perfect. If anyone hits blockers, drop screenshots/logs here. :sparkles:
